licence.scope: Owner is the DESI collaboration (LBNL-managed). DESI data licence and acknowledgments page (the owner's data terms, step 2): CC BY 4.0 for DESI data available through data.desi.lbl.gov, with citation of the data release paper and the acknowledgement below. It does not name the filter curve specifically; the page SVO cites, https://www.desi.lbl.gov/spectrograph/, carries only a footer 'Copyright © 2018 Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument [DESI]'. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
